name: OpenAPI
shortDescription: Converts OpenAPI specifications into callable tools with authentication, runtime validation, and a security policy engine for controlled API access.

rawRecord.name: OpenAPI
rawRecord.short_description: Converts OpenAPI specifications into callable tools with authentication, runtime validation, and a security policy engine for controlled API access.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Converts OpenAPI 3.x specifications into callable tools, enabling interaction with any REST API that has an API definition. Supports API key, Bearer, Basic, and OAuth2/OpenID Connect authentication methods. Includes a security policy engine with tool allowlists and denylists, host restrictions, and method filtering. Provides runtime response validation through Zod and AJV schema checking, Prometheus metrics for observability, and multiple transport options including stdio, streamable-http, and SSE.
